critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1486 lines — same note as iter22: approaching maintainability limits; please extract student/*, admin/* and devices endpoints into separate routers.

useAntiCheat.js onClip: when selection is empty (e.g. CSS user-select:none applied by lockdown mode) the internal copy path silently does nothing. In real browsers Ctrl+C on a non-selectable region never fires anyway, but if the exam enters .lockdown mode internal copy becomes impossible — intended but worth documenting for teachers.

DevicesPanel's thead has `colSpan={7 + DESKTOP.length}` for the empty state but current table layout has 6 fixed cols + DESKTOP cols = 6 + N (Poste, Utilisateur, Version, [tools], Dernière vérif, Élève/examen, Apps fermées = 6 non-tool cols). colSpan is off-by-one (should be 6+DESKTOP.length). Cosmetic only.

DeviceIn.tools accepts arbitrary keys — server-side filters to {wordq, lexibar, antidote}. Fine, but path field is truncated to 300 chars silently; consider returning a validation error for very long paths.
Admin devices listing has no pagination/limit beyond .to_list(2000); fine for school scale but worth a note.
